review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer/ Administrator
review_candidates.description: About Us Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI — products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns. Job Description This is a remote position. Embrace’s EdTech portfolio includes software companies providing solutions for education institutions. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Systems Engineer/Administrator to independently manage production infrastructure across our EdTech portfolio, including Rackspace-hosted private-cloud environments. This is a full-time, hands-on production operations role, with primary responsibility for Windows Server, Microsoft SQL Server, infrastructure monitoring, backups, disaster recovery, patching, troubleshooting, security hardening, and overall system reliability. You will be the primary infrastructure resource responsible for keeping our EdTech production environments stable, secure, and available. You must be comfortable independently troubleshooting and resolving infrastructure issues, coordinating with hosting providers, and working closely with Engineering and Security teams across the portfolio. Beyond day-to-day administration, you will help improve infrastructure reliability, performance, capacity planning, automation, documentation, and cost efficiency. The immediate and ongoing focus of this position is the production infrastructure supporting our EdTech portfolio. Over time, there may be opportunities to support infrastructure initiatives across other Embrace portfolio companies, depending on business needs. Technology You Will Work With Rackspace private-cloud and managed hosting environments Microsoft Windows Server and Active Directory Microsoft SQL Server, including clustering and high availability VMware and virtualized infrastructure Apache HTTP Server and Tomcat hosting Java web applications SAML/Shibboleth single sign-on Cloudflare, CDN, WAF, DNS, and TLS certificates Backup, recovery, and disaster recovery systems Infrastructure monitoring, logging, and security tools PowerShell and infrastructure automation tools Storage, networking, firewalls, and vulnerability management platforms What You Will Own Production Infrastructure and System Administration Independently manage the day-to-day operations of production infrastructure across the EdTech portfolio, including Rackspace-hosted environments. Administer Windows Server environments, including server configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, patching, upgrades, and performance optimization. Manage Active Directory, Group Policy, service accounts, privileged access, and related infrastructure dependencies. Monitor server health, resource utilization, storage, networking, availability, and overall infrastructure performance. Coordinate with Rackspace and other hosting providers on infrastructure incidents, maintenance, upgrades, and service issues. Maintain infrastructure architecture diagrams, configuration records, operational procedures, and system documentation. SQL Server Administration Administer and maintain Microsoft SQL Server production environments. Manage SQL Server high availability, Always On configurations, Windows failover clustering, and related infrastructure. Perform and validate database backups, restores, and point-in-time recovery. Monitor SQL Server performance, availability, storage utilization, and database health. Troubleshoot database performance issues, connectivity problems, failed jobs, and production incidents. Manage SQL Agent jobs, index maintenance, integrity checks, upgrades, and database maintenance activities. Work with Engineering and specialized database consultants when complex issues require additional expertise. Backup, Disaster Recovery, and Business Continuity Own backup and recovery operations across servers, databases, and critical infrastructure components. Regularly validate backups through scheduled restore testing. Maintain and test disaster recovery procedures and recovery plans. Monitor backup success, storage availability, retention policies, and offsite or protected backup integrity. Document recovery procedures, recovery objectives, and operational dependencies. Identify and address gaps that could affect business continuity or production availability. Application Infrastructure and Production Support Support Apache HTTP Server, Tomcat, and Java application hosting infrastructure. Manage TLS certificates, DNS, domains, reverse proxies, and related application infrastructure. Support SAML/Shibboleth authentication infrastructure and troubleshoot connectivity or configuration issues. Work with Engineering to diagnose production issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers. Support application deployments, infrastructure changes, and upgrades with appropriate testing and rollback procedures. Troubleshoot production incidents and coordinate resolution with Engineering, Security, and hosting providers. Security, Monitoring, and Patch Management Implement and maintain infrastructure security configurations, server hardening, and access controls. Manage regular Windows Server and infrastructure patching, including maintenance windows, validation, and rollback planning. Work with the Security team on vulnerability remediation, security findings, and infrastructure risk reduction. Support Cloudflare/WAF configurations, firewall rules, access controls, and security-related infrastructure changes. Maintain infrastructure monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational health checks. Support security audits and compliance requirements by providing infrastructure documentation, operational records, and evidence. Ensure critical infrastructure alerts and production issues are investigated and resolved promptly. Infrastructure Optimization and Automation Monitor infrastructure utilization, performance, capacity, and growth trends. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency. Recommend improvements to server configurations, storage utilization, backup systems, and infrastructure architecture. Automate repetitive administration, monitoring, maintenance, and validation tasks using PowerShell or other appropriate scripting tools. Maintain operational runbooks, checklists, and documented procedures to reduce manual effort and improve consistency. Evaluate infrastructure lifecycle requirements, including upgrades, replacements, capacity expansion, and vendor renewals. Production Ownership and Operational Support Serve as the primary hands-on infrastructure resource for the EdTech portfolio. Take ownership of infrastructure-related production incidents from investigation through resolution. Coordinate with internal teams, external consultants, and hosting providers when additional support is needed. Participate in scheduled maintenance and provide support for urgent production issues during evenings or weekends as required. Maintain clear incident records, troubleshooting documentation, and follow-up actions. Proactively identify infrastructure risks and recommend corrective actions before they affect production. How You Will Work With Others Engineering Team: Engineering owns application code and software releases. You own infrastructure and production operations. You will work together on deployments, troubleshooting, performance issues, and infrastructure changes. Security Team: Security defines policies, standards, and risk priorities. You implement and maintain infrastructure security controls, patching, access management, and operational safeguards. Hosting Providers: You coordinate with Rackspace and other vendors, manage operational escalations, and ensure hosting services meet availability and performance expectations. External Consultants: You may work with specialized database or infrastructure consultants when needed, while retaining primary ownership of day-to-day operations. Embrace Technology Group: You may collaborate with other portfolio companies on infrastructure-related initiatives as business needs evolve. Requirements 7+ years of hands-on Windows Server administration in production SaaS, enterprise, or hosted application environments. Strong Microsoft SQL Server administration experience, including Always On/high availability, clustering, backups, restores, point-in-time recovery, SQL Agent jobs, maintenance, and performance troubleshooting. Experience independently managing production infrastructure in private-cloud, hosted, VMware, or other virtualized environments. Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, Windows failover clustering, service accounts, and server security. Experience managing compute, storage, networking, server capacity, and infrastructure availability. Hands-on experience supporting Apache HTTP Server, Tomcat, TLS certificates, DNS, and web application hosting infrastructure. Experience with Cloudflare or similar CDN/WAF platforms, firewall configurations, and infrastructure security controls. Strong production troubleshooting skills, including monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, change management, and operational recovery. Experience managing backup systems, performing database and server restores, and testing disaster recovery procedures. Experience with server patching, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, and operational monitoring tools. Working knowledge of PowerShell scripting for system administration, automation, monitoring, and operational checks. Experience coordinating with hosting providers and managing infrastructure-related vendor escalations. Ability to independently manage production infrastructure without relying on a dedicated infrastructure team. Strong documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills. Willingness to participate in scheduled maintenance and urgent production support during evenings and weekends. Nice to Have Experience with Rackspace or similar managed private-cloud hosting providers. Experience with VMware infrastructure administration and virtualization technologies. Experience with SAML/Shibboleth authentication and single sign-on. Familiarity with Solr, Elasticsearch, or similar search platforms. Experience supporting Java-based enterprise applications. Experience with SOC 2, HECVAT, GovRAMP/StateRAMP, or similar security and compliance requirements. Experience with infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible or Terraform. Experience with immutable or protected backup storage and automated recovery testing. Familiarity with SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, and security monitoring platforms. Experience with infrastructure capacity planning, cost optimization, and lifecycle management. Exposure to AWS or Azure environments. Experience creating infrastructure health dashboards, monitoring reports, and operational runbooks. How We Hire Our interview process focuses on practical, hands-on production experience. Candidates should be prepared to discuss: Windows Server environments they have personally administered. SQL Server clustering, backups, restores, and production troubleshooting. Production incidents they have independently investigated and resolved. Their experience managing private-cloud or virtualized infrastructure. Backup and disaster recovery procedures they have implemented or tested. How they would approach taking ownership of an existing production environment. The process may include practical troubleshooting or recovery scenarios using sample materials provided by the interview team. We may request references who can speak to your hands-on technical capabilities and independent operational ownership. Embrace Software is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from every background and do not discriminate on any basis protected by law. Benefits Competitive salary commensurate with experience. Opportunities for career advancement and professional development. Experience collaborating with a diverse, global team. Comprehensive Health Benefits/ RRSP Matching to support your wellbeing and peace of mind.

review_candidates.title: Senior Cloud Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Help build the network foundations for T&G’s cloud future. At T&G Global, we grow, market and distribute fresh produce across New Zealand and around the world. Behind that is an increasingly connected technology environment, and we’re investing in how we build it for the future. We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Network Engineer to join our Data & Platform Engineering team and play a key role in shaping our move towards a cloud-first operating model. This isn’t simply a role maintaining an existing network. You’ll help establish strong foundations across cloud and on-premises environments, bringing modern cloud networking practices into an environment where there is real opportunity to influence the future approach. What you’ll be doing You’ll take technical ownership of networking across a varied hybrid environment, helping turn business needs into secure, scalable and practical network solutions. You’ll Be Involved In Designing and building our AWS network foundations, including VPC architecture, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Firewall and DNS. Building infrastructure as code using Terraform, with GitHub, and CI/CD practices. Creating a consistent approach across cloud and on-premises networking, rather than treating them as separate worlds. Working across Cisco Meraki networking, Palo Alto firewalls, Meraki SD-WAN and operational site connectivity. Solving complex network and connectivity issues end to end, sometimes working directly with the people experiencing the problem. Building strong documentation, standards and network designs that give us a clear picture of our environment and make future change easier. Partnering across IT, Cyber Security, business teams, operational sites and external technology partners. What will make you successful We’re looking for someone who combines strong networking fundamentals with modern cloud engineering capability. You’ll bring experience across cloud and on-premises networking and be comfortable working with AWS, Terraform, GitHub and CI/CD pipelines . Programming or scripting capability matters too. We want to automate and engineer our network environment, rather than rely on manual configuration. Just as importantly, you’ll be someone who can operate at a senior level. That means being able to take a business requirement, ask the right questions, work through ambiguity and turn it into a thoughtful network design and implementation plan.
